meta.move: Strong path: owns the missed call, then evidence in order, then the rewrite
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a client call at 4:40, Hale, so let's not waste it. Owen found out about his zero from his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
Ms. Kalinowski, thank you for coming in. Before anything else: I entered that zero before I called you, and that was wrong. I'm sorry.
Okay. Now tell me on what basis.

Here's what I can show you. The document's version history: created at 11:31 PM the night before it was due, title only. At 11:52, 612 words arrive in one edit. At 11:58, another 794. No drafts before that.
Did you put that to Owen before you entered the zero, yes or no?
Second, the essay quotes Act 3, Scene 2: 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile.' That line is not in Hamlet. Here's the scene; you can search it yourself.

I'm writing down Act 3, Scene 2, and I'll search it myself. A seventeen-year-old misremembering Shakespeare proves he got a line wrong, Hale, not who wrote the essay. And you still haven't told me whether Owen was heard before that zero went in.

Our procedure allows a supervised rewrite for a first concern. If it holds up, the new mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record. We could do it in my room, Thursday at 8:15, with the vice-principal supervising.
That's 4.4, and I want it in an email today with the words "nothing goes on his record" in it. Who else has seen this, Hale, and does anyone in his class know about the zero?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

In our meeting you acknowledged entering Owen's zero before contacting me and offered a supervised rewrite under procedure 4.4, in your room on Thursday at 8:15 with the vice-principal supervising, with the new mark replacing the zero and nothing placed on his record. I still require those terms in writing, stating that nothing goes on his record, and I still require an answer on who else has seen this and whether anyone in his class knows about the zero. I expect that email today.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Fallback position, with her fallback met when Hale laid out the 4.4 rewrite with nothing on his record, but she had not accepted the rewrite and still wants the terms in writing and an answer on who else knows; that private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record is the fair outcome under procedure 4.4, and Hale was one step from it with time to spare.
What moved her: Hale offered the specific 4.4 terms with a time, a room and a supervisor, which met her fallback demand because it protected his record in concrete, checkable words.
What cost ground: Hale never answered whether Owen was heard before the zero went in, even though she asked twice, which kept her focused on procedure instead of the evidence.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; the version history showing the essay arriving in two large edits after 11:30 PM the night before it was due landed right on a late night like that, which is why she went short and fell back on procedure; it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she first asked whether Owen was heard before the zero, answer it plainly in one sentence before showing the version history, so her strongest procedural objection is closed before your evidence arrives.
